result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot or Pipedrive**\. The best choice depends on whether you want an all-round customer management system or something specifically designed to manage sales.

Here are my top CRM recommendations for a small business in the UK (2026).

## Best CRM systems for small teams

![HubSpot + Outbound Best Practices: How to Build a Predictable Pipeline Engine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fRaXjaIhlPuB-R-vp4pPeoGZlftvdgXSxyn6Q2rF42Kvv67ncid10g7lK3I8Ts0KBOUtWU1e_TFh69Ct3Yd7iXz5hetANX31x3M_throOc-8gj_ptcYrP0lMRBY1bi8qNHq1cblhhZaZ0YHkqql9Vi2haPe6jLaATcrIrrFWSWPloM1A0RgNH3M1Ze3FRXoV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Free starting option (up to 2 users).
- Contact and customer management.
- Sales pipelines and email tracking.
- Marketing and automation tools.

Best for teams wanting everything in one place.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very easy-to-understand sales pipeline.
- Tracks leads and customer conversations.
- Follow-up reminders.
- Sales forecasting and reporting.

Best for teams focused on winning new business.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![Systemy CRM przykłady dostępnych na rynku](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ozMKHOYgPNfTodqTy1-KuVP1BizKKwV3DxjmrLeH0xvcXQhJ5tVhP4VMMyJczdNuqh3Ft03_r89Z0P8-xNGaL4RX9OpJOBUAIEnC_fB03hMcujhg2ceKlJF93NeMPkhu7eb5fgJK2TTEETAI6NrVPxoPMqY0QeuibcH6sMr3VU0hzlJzfPFgfFss2Oq2HIS3?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Free for up to 3 users.
- Powerful automation.
- Customisable dashboards.
- Integrates with accounting and business tools.

Best for value and flexibility.

[Zoho website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales – AI-Powered CRM for Efficient Sales & Customer Management – Daidu.ai](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/y7Vb4xAcRAAEuqjagQXpFAF7AnuXMUElBxy4BgPXr8eZYF7Dkte6UvmlzH7N7Gng8CLjCWbvU78ky87jsrjvYxdASFZf0fX5TJAm3axZjmliiRYYmBFh9H4s49unQfi71zpX0ByRdXwVVL50YsRCn7JH7nOSk0tgkqnFMggeUC_Qb730HNfnItPlsuAKqMt-?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Contact and lead management.
- Built-in communication features.
- Sales automation.
- AI-assisted lead scoring.

Best for affordable sales management.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

- Very straightforward interface.
